scope: Sweep allocation failures through whole-operation AC1027 DXF writes containing a variable-size SPATIAL_FILTER, then verify rollback, same-codec retry and typed readback.

source.profile: One SPATIAL_FILTER with three 2D boundary vertices, nondefault normal and origin, front/back clipping distances, and distinct twelve-value inverse/forward transforms. No external DWG/DXF fixture is used or added.

implementation.method: Add a focused mode to the whole-operation allocation harness. Warm the writer, calibrate allocations with an existing destination, inject one-shot allocation failures at every measured offset, and check caller state, destination bytes, source-handle binding rollback and staging cleanup. Retry on the same codec and require byte-identical output plus typed readback of boundary geometry, flags, distances and both matrices.

validation.build: cmake --build build-gcc --target libdxfrw_dxf_write_allocation_transaction_tests -j4: PASS; ASan target build: PASS
validation.directRun: PASS; ASCII 94 and Binary 93 allocation offsets injected; caller/destination/identity rollback, stage cleanup, same-codec retry and typed readback passed.

limitations: Generated transaction evidence for one AC1027 profile does not establish producer-authored field combinations or version-wide interoperability.
The test does not prove the filter is correctly attached to a block reference, nor does it qualify native clipping behavior.
No support claim is promoted and no drawing fixture is committed.
nextAction: Continue the P6-G public-writer inventory and select another exact uncovered variable-size route or version-specific variant.
